description.value: The Kelowna Downtown branch of the Okanagan Regional Library is a large, full-service public library in the city centre, part of a 30-branch regional system serving over 399,000 people across the Okanagan. It houses an impressive Makerspace with a 3D printer, laser cutter, audio recording studio, and video production gear. Touring cyclists will find a welcoming public space with computers, Wi-Fi, and bookable meeting rooms in a convenient downtown location.
